items.name: Radisson Blu Hotel Marseille Vieux Port
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Radisson Blu Hotel Marseille Vieux Port. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located in Marseille overlooking the Vieux Port, Radisson Blu Hotel Marseille Vieux Port is a 4-star hotel. It offers an outdoor swimming pool overlooking Fort Saint-Nicholas and a fitness room with a panoramic view of the main monuments of the city. Free WiFi access is available.

The air-conditioned guest rooms feature either a Provencal or an African décor. Some rooms have a view of the port and a Nespresso coffee machine. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Bathrobes and slippers are provided in the suites.

The Quai du 7eme restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine and proposes buffet breakfast every morning and guests can also enjoy cocktails and tapas in the Bar, with a view over the port.

A boules pitch can be enjoyed on the interior courtyard. With a 24-hour reception, Radisson Blu Hotel Marseille Vieux Port is also partnered with the 5 Mondes Spa just 40 metres away, where beauty treatments are possible at a discounted rate.

Indigo La Criée Car Park is just 80 metres away, available for an additional charge.

Pets welcome - Dog's up to 8kg, Supplement charged at €30.00 per day payable direct to hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Grand Hotel Beauvau Marseille Vieux-Port - MGallery Collection
items.description:
Grand Hôtel Beauvau Marseille Vieux Port - MGallery is an elegant 4-star hotel in the centre of Marseille. Grand Hotel Beauvau’s bar, Le Beauvau, invites guests to enjoy a drink while looking out over Vieux Port and the Mediterranean Sea. Free WiFi access is available.

Decorated with Empire or Napoleon III furniture, rooms and suites at Grand Hôtel Beauvau Marseille Vieux Port - MGallery are air-conditioned and offer satellite and cable TV. The private bathrooms feature a bath and shower, large mirror, hairdryer, bathrobes, slippers and toiletries.

A Provencal-style Breakfast featuring local produce is served daily in the comfort of your room or in the breakfast room, which offers views of the port. A variety of hot meals and cold snacks are also available with 24-hour room service.

The front desk is open 24 hours a day and guests will be welcomed in French, Italian, Spanish or English.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Located on Marseille Vieux Port, Hotel Belle-Vue Vieux-Port is an eco-friendly hotel offering views of the Notre-Dame de la Garde, Saint Jean Fort and Pharo Garden. Each room at the Hotel Belle-Vue is also equipped with air-conditioning and a flat-screen satellite TV, and most have large windows with views of the port. The private bathrooms have a hairdryer and either a shower or a bathtub. Ironing facilities are available.

A continental breakfast is provided daily and can be enjoyed in the guest rooms. The hotel’s restaurant serves traditional cuisine from the south of France. La Caravelle cocktail bar has a balcony where guests can enjoy a drink.

The 24-hour reception offers local tourist information and newspapers are available every morning.

Featuring a cocktail bar, garden and a fitness centre on the 6th floor, NH Collection Marseille is located in the new business and leisure district of Marseille, La Joliette. Located between the port and the city centre, the building was inaugurated by Napoleon III in 1864 and preserves its original style.

Rooms at NH Collection Marseille feature elegant décor and offer an electric kettle, coffee machine and private bathroom.

Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant, which serves local and international dishes with a variety of local cheeses and wines.Guests can also find a cocktail bar located close to the hotel reception, as well as a garden in the centre of the hotel.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property as well as 4 meeting rooms.

Museum of European and Mediterranean Civilisations is 900 metres from NH Collection Marseille, while Palais du Pharo is 1.4 km away. items.description:
Hôtel 96 is set in a 19th-century house with a garden and an outdoor swimming pool, located on the outskirts of Marseille and a 5-minute drive from the beach. It offers spacious rooms with modern décors and free Wi-Fi access. Guests can relax in the on-site sauna or enjoy a massage.

Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, an iPod docking station, a minibar and a safety deposit box. Every room also has an en suite bathroom with a bathtub or walk-in shower. A continental breakfast is served daily and includes French pastries, fresh orange juice homemade cakes and jams.

The property provides paid parking at €6 per night on site. Hôtel 96 is situated on the edge of the Calanques National Park.

The centre of Marseille and Saint Charles Train Station are a 25-minute drive away or 40-minutes by public transport. Guests can take either Bus line 22 or 23  from Metro 2 stop Rond Point du PradoCouples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: ibis Styles Marseille Centre Prado Place Castellane
items.description:
Ibis Styles Marseille Centre Prado Place Castellane : design, confort et emplacement idéal au cœur de Marseille.

Bienvenue à l'Ibis Styles Marseille Centre Prado Place Castellane, un hôtel moderne et dynamique, idéalement situé au cœur de Marseille, à quelques pas de la célèbre place Castellane.
Notre hôtel, au design contemporain et coloré, vous accueille dans une ambiance chaleureuse et conviviale, incarnant à la perfection l'esprit La Dolce Massalia : un art de vivre marseillais alliant élégance, détente et énergie urbaine. Que vous voyagiez pour affaires, pour une escapade romantique ou pour des vacances inoubliables, vous profiterez d'un cadre confortable et inspirant. Des chambres confortables au design inspirant.

Dès votre arrivée, laissez-vous séduire par notre design raffiné et notre concept La Dolce Massalia, où chaque détail est soigneusement pensé pour allier confort, modernité et art de vivre méditerranéen.
Nos chambres climatisées et parfaitement insonorisées offrent un véritable havre de tranquillité au cœur de la ville. Chaque chambre dispose :
• d’une literie haut de gamme pour des nuits paisibles et reposantes
• Une salle de bains moderne avec douche, sèche-cheveux et produits d'accueil écologiques
• Une télévision à écran plat de 43 pouces avec chaînes satellite
• Une atmosphère lumineuse, élégante et apaisante, idéale après une journée de travail ou de découverte.
Les petites attentions qui font toute la différence.

Pour rendre votre séjour encore plus agréable :
• Petit-déjeuner gastronomique inclus, avec un buffet sucré-salé composé de produits frais, de viennoiseries croustillantes et d'un coin plats chauds
• Wi-Fi haut débit gratuit dans tout l'hôtel
• Climatisation individuelle pour un confort optimal en toute saison
• Réception ouverte 24h/24 pour répondre à toutes vos questions
Un emplacement exceptionnel pour découvrir Marseille
Grâce à son emplacement privilégié, notre hôtel est le point de départ idéal pour explorer la Cité phocéenne :
• La station Castellane (métro, tramway et bus) se trouve à quelques mètres seulement
• Le Vieux-Port est à environ 10 minutes à pied, une agréable promenade pour découvrir l'ambiance marseillaise
• De nombreux restaurants, cafés, boutiques et magasins se trouvent à proximité immédiate, ainsi que nos restaurants partenaires soigneusement sélectionnés. L'hôtel bénéficie également d'une excellente accessibilité : la gare de Marseille Saint-Charles et le Vieux-Port sont rapidement accessibles en métro, et l'aéroport de Marseille Provence est facilement joignable en voiture ou via des navettes dédiées. Pour vos besoins de stationnement, un parking public couvert (Indigo Castellane) est situé à quelques mètres de l'hôtel. L'ibis Styles Marseille Castellane est le point de départ idéal pour explorer Marseille en toute sérénité, offrant un accès direct aux lignes de métro M1 et M2, dans un cadre moderne, élégant et accueillant.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: ASSAS Hotels
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
The apart'hotel Citadines Prado Chanot Marseille is located in the city center, 600m from the congress and exhibition center Marseille Chanot. On foot, you can reach the 26th Centenary Park in 10 minutes, the Velodrome Stadium in 15 minutes, the Old Port and the Basilica of Notre-Dame de la Garde in 35 minutes. The residence can be reached in 15 mn by metro from the railway station.

The air-conditioned studios and apartments have free high-speed WiFi access, a flat-screen TV, a safe box, a coffee machine and an electric kettle. All have a separate, fully equipped kitchen with hob, microwave, fridge and dishwasher( only in the appartment for 4 persons), as well as a bathroom with bathtub.

The serviced apartment offers hot drinks in the lobby and a breakfast area. A 7am to 10 pm-hour reception is at your disposal. A la carte services: launderette. Private parking upon availability, charges will apply.

With Uber Eats, enjoy free delivery in our residence! Get your favourite dishes delivered to your apartment with this exclusive partnership.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Founded in 2011 in Chamonix, Assas Hotels now has 15 establishments across the French and Swiss Alps, Paris and the south of France.
The group designs or reposition existing establishments around a single requirement: authenticity. Each establishment is designed as a unique response to its environment, the identity of the community that welcomes it and those who bring it to life, in a responsible and sustainable approach to hospitality.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
In the heart of the Prado district, Soléo Prado, a hotel in Marseille, welcomes you in a warm and bright atmosphere inspired by the energy of the South. Ideally located a stone's throw from Avenue du Prado, a few minutes from the Stade Vélodrome, Parc Chanot and close to Saint-Joseph Hospital, our hotel is the perfect place to discover Marseille, attend an event or enjoy a comfortable stay with your family, as a couple or on a business trip. 
Whether you are coming for a cultural break, a family getaway, a business event or a match at the Stade Vélodrome, Marseille combines charm, energy and Mediterranean lifestyle.
The Prado district, with its central location and numerous shops and services, is an ideal starting point for your hotel in Marseille.

hostInfo.name: Odalys Vacances
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Marseille, the 2nd largest city in France, offers an incredible choice of historical, natural and cultural sites to see and visit. The Notre Dame basilica offering spectacular 360 degree views of the city, the Frioul islands and the famous "calanques" and the Mucem museum are just a few sites to add to your list. You will also be able to enjoy endless sports and leisure activities during your visit to Marseille.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
In the Euromediterranee business district in La Joliette in Marseille, the Odalys City Apart'hotel Centre Euromed is located on the first 11 floors of an avant-garde building, the Porte Bleue, designed by Jean-Baptiste Pietri. The establishment is ideally located and offers exceptional facilities and services for your business trip or holiday in Marseille. This apart'hotel houses 252 airconditioned studio apartments and apartments sleeping up to 4 people.
This establishment is only 2km from the Old Port and just 2 stops on the metro away from the Saint Charles TGV train station, giving easy access to the city's sites and tourist attractions. The Parc des Expositions Chanot, where the city's main exhibitions are held, is 30 minutes away by metro.
At your disposal : Well-being area with sauna and hammam (extra charge), Fitness area, Indoor swimming pool (extra charge), Fitness room, Wifi, Laundry facilities (extra charge), Underground, public car park (extra charge)

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

New Hotel Le Quai - Vieux Port is located in central Marseille, overlooking the Old Port and La Canebière shopping street. This hotel offers soundproofed rooms with air-conditioning and satellite TV. Free WiFi access is available. 

The hotel was completely renovated in 2018 and 2019. The rooms feature a desk and a private bathroom. They are also equipped with a courtesy tray with a kettle. A bottle of water is provided upon arrival. 

A buffet breakfast is served daily in the breakfast room or in guest rooms. The multilingual staff can also provide information on the local area at the 24-hour reception. 

Famous landmarks close to the hotel include Notre Dame de la Garde, the Vieille Charité cultural centre, MUCEM museum, Pharo Palace and Saint Victor's Abbey. 

New Hotel Le Quai is situated opposite the Vieux-Port Hotel de Ville Metro Station, a 5-minute walk from the World Trade Center and 300 meters from the Belsunce Alcazar Tramway. Chanot Exhibition Centre can be reached in 10 minutes on the metro. The Panier district is just a 10-minute walk away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Request Type : Property Description
From the bedrooms to the ground floor, our hotel has been completely renovated. We are now ready to welcome you in a fully revitalized and improved setting for your comfort.

Just 2 km from the Old Port, the ibis Marseille Euroméditerranée hotel offers modern accommodation with a 24-hour reception, free newspapers and free WiFi. It also has a restaurant, a bar and a terrace.
The new restaurant concept is called T.A.T.A. Euromed and was designed to satisfy your appetite for authentic Mediterranean cuisine. Whether dining solo or with friends, enjoy flavourful dishes all made on our premises. Open 7 days a week, our Joliette restaurant-bar and its sunny terrace provide a lively destination for eating, drinking or catching up on work.

The air-conditioned hotel’s rooms feature a TV with satellite and cable channels. They all have an en suite bathroom with hairdryer and shower.

A buffet breakfast composed of sweet and savoury dishes such as eggs, fruit salad, yogurts and juices is served every day. Pastries baked on site and fresh French Madeleine cakes are also on offer, as well as a hot beverage and a piece of fruit to take away. Outside of regular breakfast hours guests can also enjoy a lighter option, available from 04:00 a.m.

Bus lines, a metro station and a tram stop can be found within 400 metres of the property and allow guests to easily access Saint-Charles train station, the city centre and the Old Port. Parc Chanot Exhibition Centre and the Catalans Beaches are 4 km away, while Notre-Dame de la Garde is 3.5 km away. Underground public parking is available nearby at a discounted cost.

Marseille-Marignane Airport is 23 km away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
